name: DSpatch mission loop
description: A long assignment on DSpatch's own repository, carried across many sub-goals and several runs: reconcile and choose, plan, research, implement, review with rework, assess the whole. Each run is a batch that ends with the working state saved.
resourceRootNote: The DSpatch working copy this file is filed in, two levels up from .dspatch/loops. The graph and every role live there and are referenced, not copied.
notes: DSP-208, prepared for the adaptive-execution mission. Start it from chat with Use loop and the mandate in docs/missions/adaptive-execution/BRIEF.md, section Operating the run. It works on the folders opened in the workspace, which for this mission is the DSpatch working copy itself. Its continuity is the working-state file docs/missions/adaptive-execution/STATE.md, not the run: a run that ends for any reason is continued by starting a new one with the same mandate.
